description: T-4734's scratch run of probes/t4128-pivot-spike exported: the pivot spike's R (refreshOnLoad over a formula source), G (a numeric range group) and S (a #SPILL! collapse); K, with a calculated field, is not imported and so not exported. Every pivot is a refreshOnLoad builder pivot the engine renders before the export writes its grouped cache (export/pivots/groups.rs); Excel re-renders it on open, and the probe's GETPIVOTDATA cells read it.
